title: 第17章 谷口危机第18章 攻他下盘
lines: 在葬剑谷这鬼地方待久了，连日子都过得糊里糊涂。
云澈估摸着，自打跟林虎搭伙，怎么也得有个把月了。
这期间，两人互相照应，白天狩猎、搜寻，晚上轮流守夜，日子虽然提心吊胆，但总算比一个人等死强。
云澈的“恢复”
情况“良好”
，在林虎看来，这位云师弟简直是天赋异禀，不仅身体逐渐硬朗起来，那手剑法更是越来越诡异难测，时而灵巧如风，时而沉重如山，搞得他经常看得一愣一愣的，越发认定云澈是注定要一飞冲天的真龙。
而云澈，则利用这段时间，不断尝试融合两种剑法，虽然距离真正融会贯通还差得远，但实战能力确实提升了不少。
更重要的是，他又幸运地在一头特别强壮的蚀骨蜥巢穴附近，找到了第二块小指头大小的剑髓石碎片，这让他心里踏实了不少。
食物储备得差不多了，身上的伤也好利索了，两人一合计，这葬剑谷终究不是久留之地。
谁知道哪天会不会冒出更厉害的妖兽，或者云昊那王八蛋又派什么狠角色下来？夜长梦多，必须尽快离开！
“妈的，终于要离开这鬼地方了！”
林虎显得很兴奋，摩拳擦掌，
“等出去了，老子先找个地方洗个热水澡，再狠狠吃他三天三夜！”
云澈相对冷静些，提醒道：
“林兄，别高兴太早。
谷口肯定有人把守，而且，绝不会再是王龙那种货色了。”
林虎满不在乎地挥挥手：
“怕啥！
有你我在，只要不是内门那些变态师兄亲自来，寻常守谷弟子，来一个打一个，来两个打一双！”
他对云澈的实力有种盲目的信心。
云澈没再多说，但心里的警惕已经提到了最高。
云昊知道自己没死，还“恢复”
了部分实力，怎么可能只派杂鱼来？接下来的关卡，才是真正的考验。
两人收拾妥当，主要是带上风干的兽肉和清水，沿着记忆中谷口的方向，小心翼翼地前进。
越靠近谷口，雾气似乎淡了一些，但那种压抑的死寂感却丝毫未减，反而因为即将面对未知的危险而更加令人心头发紧。
终于，在穿过一片布满剑痕的乱石坡后，前方隐约出现了葬剑谷那标志性的、扭曲蠕动的光膜结界——那是谷口阵法所在。
只要穿过那里，就能离开这个鬼地方！
然而，就在距离光膜尚有百余丈远的一处高地上，赫然立着两道身影！
那两人穿着青岚宗标准的外门弟子服饰，但材质明显比杂役和王龙之流要好上不少，腰间佩剑寒光闪闪，一看就不是凡品。
他们一左一右，像两尊门神般堵在通往光膜的必经之路上，眼神锐利，气息沉稳，远非王龙那种虚浮之辈可比。
云澈瞳孔一缩，心头一沉。
果然是剑徒中期！
而且一看就是实战经验丰富的老手！
林虎也收起了轻松的表情，脸色凝重起来，低声道：
content_en:
After staying in this ghost place like Sword Burial Valley for so long, I feel like I'm living in a blur.
Yun Che estimated that since he teamed up with Lin Hu, he would have to live for a long time.
During this period, the two of them took care of each other, hunting and searching during the day, and taking turns to keep watch at night. Although their days were scary, it was still better than waiting to die alone.
Yun Che’s “Recovery”
Condition "good"
, in Lin Hu's view, this Junior Brother Yun was simply gifted. Not only was his body gradually getting tougher, but his sword skills were becoming more and more weird and unpredictable. Sometimes he was as smart as the wind, and sometimes as heavy as a mountain. He was often stunned for a moment, and he became more and more convinced that Yun Che was a true dragon destined to soar into the sky.
Yun Che, on the other hand, used this period of time to constantly try to fuse the two sword techniques. Although he was still far from truly mastering them, his actual combat ability had indeed improved a lot.
More importantly, he was lucky enough to find a second piece of sword marrow stone fragment the size of a little finger near the nest of a particularly strong bone-eating lizard, which made him feel more at ease.
The food reserves are almost complete, and the wounds on the body are healed. Together, the two of them realize that this Sword Burial Valley is not a place to stay for a long time after all.
Who knows if a more powerful monster will appear one day, or if that bastard Yun Hao will send some ruthless characters down? The nights are long and the dreams are many, we must leave as soon as possible!
"Damn it, I'm finally leaving this hellish place!"
Lin Hu seemed very excited and gearing up.
"When we get out, I'll find a place to take a hot bath first, and then I'll eat him for three days and three nights!"
Yun Che was relatively calm and reminded:
"Brother Lin, don't be too happy too early.
There must be someone guarding Taniguchi, and it's definitely not someone like Wang Lung anymore. "
Lin Hu waved his hand nonchalantly:
"What are you afraid of!
With you and me here, as long as those perverted senior brothers from the inner sect don't come in person, ordinary Shougu disciples will come to fight one, or two to fight a pair! "
He has blind confidence in Yun Che's strength.
Yun Che didn't say anything more, but the vigilance in his heart was already raised to the highest level.
Yun Hao knew he was not dead and "recovered"
How could it be possible to send only miscellaneous fish if you lost part of your strength? The next level is the real test.
The two packed up, mainly bringing dried animal meat and water, and cautiously moved forward along the direction of the valley entrance in their memory.
As we get closer to the mouth of the valley, the fog seems to lighten a little, but the oppressive sense of death has not diminished at all. On the contrary, it is even more nerve-wracking because we are about to face unknown dangers.
Finally, after passing through a rocky slope covered with sword marks, the iconic twisted and wriggling light film barrier of the Sword Burial Valley loomed ahead - that was where the Taniguchi Formation was located.
As long as you go through there, you can get out of this hellish place!
However, on a high ground more than a hundred feet away from the light film, two figures stood impressively!
The two of them were wearing the standard outer disciple clothing of the Qinglan Sect, but the material was obviously much better than that of the servants and Wang Long. The swords on their waists were shining with cold light, and they looked like they were not ordinary at first glance.
One on the left and one on the right, they were blocking the only way to the light film like two door gods. Their eyes were sharp and their auras were calm. They were far from being comparable to the frivolous people like Wang Lung.
Yun Che's pupils shrank and his heart sank.
Sure enough, he is in the middle stage of Swordsmanship!
And at first glance, he looks like a veteran with rich practical experience!
Lin Hu also put away his relaxed expression, his face became serious, and he whispered:
